header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH AT KARACHI
Date Order with signature of Judge
1. For orders on office objections No. 1 to 3.
2. For hearing of CMA No. 26780 of 2026 (Stay)
body: Mr. Ali Asghar, Focal Person, Home Department, Government of Sindh.

Inspector Naveed Iqbal Randhawa, SDPO, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, District East ASP Iqbal Hassan DSP, Yousufuddin, Central Prison Karachi, DSP Sajid Gujjar, DSP/Legal on behalf of AIGP Legal CPO. ------------------------------------------ Reply alongwith relevant documents filed on behalf of respondent No.5 are taken on record.

Learned AAG states at the Bar that the detenue, Muhammad Imran Siddiqui, has been released; hence, the petition in hand, has become infructuous and seeks its disposal. In support thereof, he places on record a copy of order issued by the Home Department, Government of Sindh, bearing No. SO(Judl-II)/HD/06-01/2026 (Oct- 15) dated 27.10.2026, whereby the detention orders issued under Section 3(1) of the Sindh Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960, have been withdrawn, including the detention order with regard to the detenue, whose name appears at Serial No. 10 in the list of sixty (60) persons, with directions for his release, if not required in any other case.
In view of the aforesaid statement made by learned AAG, the petition stands disposed of as having become infructuous alongwith pending application(s), if any.
Judge Head of the Const. Benches J u d g e SAJID
